description: This PHP source file defines a class named 'http' that provides utility methods for fetching web content, handling caching mechanisms, and parsing HTML tables into data structures or XML. The class includes methods for making HTTP requests (including through proxies), managing cache files based on TTL, and extracting data from HTML tables into arrays or XML formats. It is designed to facilitate screen-scraping with caching and data extraction capabilities, relevant for web data collection tasks within the project.

classes.name: http
classes.description: A utility class for fetching web content with cache management, HTTP request handling, and HTML table parsing for data extraction and transformation.

methods.name: http
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize default properties for an http object, including user agent and referer headers based on server variables.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL with optional caching based on TTL. Handles cache validation, establishing connections, and reading response headers and body.

methods.description: Private method that establishes a socket connection to retrieve data from a URL, with support for proxy and authentication.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Private method to open and retrieve data from a cached file.

methods.description: Private method to save fetched HTTP headers and body to a cache file.

methods.description: Private method that retrieves the last modification timestamp of the cache file.
